title: Exceptional guide
text: Fede was an exceptional guide! His deep knowledge of the history of Albaicín and Sacromonte brought every street and story to life. Friendly, engaging, and truly passionate—highly recommended!
author: Iva_P

title: My guide had so much...
text: My guide had so much knowledge about the people who live / lived in this area. It was all fascinating and new to me., especially regarding the cave homes and their inhabitants. Highly recommended!
author: Jacqueline_A

title: Albaicin by night
text: Wandering the narrow streets of the Albaicin at night and an impromptu  tour of. Sacromento cave home were definite highlights.  Paloma’s deep understanding of the history, culture and socio-political past is impressive. An evening well spent.
author: Jan_L

title: Fabulous Tour, Fantastic Guide!
text: We loved this tour with Lorena!  She was an amazing tour guide; very informative, helpful and friendly. Walking through lovely Albaicin was peaceful and fun!  Lorena answered our questions and recommended things to check out the rest our or trip. I highly recommend this private tour!
author: Leslie_G

title: ALBACIN AT NIGHT
text: This is an excellent preparation for an Alhambra visit. It is strenuous so be prepared for a long uphill climb. We did it at night and there were multiple viewpoints of the Alhambra lit at night. At the plaza in front of Saint Nicolas Church the city views also spectacular.
author: William_W

title: After or before touring Alhambra do this walking tour
text: Virginia excellent guide. We learned a lot about the history and neighborhoods. Glad we picked 9am first tour. Any later would be very hot 🥵
author: Wendy_R

title: Great for first time visit to Granada
text: Wonderful private tour with Laura. She was amazing and her English was very good to understand. She gave us a great summary of the history of Granada , Albaycin, and Sacramento. We walked up steep hills to get great views of the city and got to see the caves. We really enjoyed this walking tour.
author: Trek740797
